$doc: STDERR PUMP VECTORS — one table, two test suites (Phase 18.7, #401/#396).
Both shells pump the .NET runtime's stderr into their own log: Kotlin
BnStderrLogcatPump on Android, Swift BnStderrPump on iOS. Each parses a line
with its own BnLogFormat.parse and forwards it at the parsed level. The two
pumps are hand-written twins, so the table they must satisfy is written ONCE
here and tools/BlazorNative.WireGen emits it for Swift and Kotlin.
Every vector expects the line to be FORWARDED. There is deliberately no
`forwarded: false` case: on 2026-11-11 the owner decided that the managed level
is the only gate. The shell level (`shellLevel`) is set on the shell log before
the line is pumped, and it must NOT suppress a line the managed side emitted.
A vector that expected a drop would re-introduce the second gate.
Fields: `shellLevel` is the shell log level in force; `line` is the raw stderr
line; `level`, `category` and `message` are the forwarded record. Levels are the
BnLogLevel ordinals: 1 Error, 2 Warn, 3 Info, 4 Debug, 5 Verbose. An unprefixed
line is forwarded at Warn under the category `native`, whole.
TO ADD A CASE: add it here, run `dotnet run --project tools/BlazorNative.WireGen`,
and commit the regenerated files. Never hand-edit a .g.* file.

vectors.name: warn-at-error
vectors.why: a Warn line passes a shell set to Error: the managed level is the only gate

vectors.name: unprefixed-at-error
vectors.why: an unprefixed line is a native fault: forwarded whole at Warn whatever the shell level

vectors.name: debug-at-warn
vectors.why: a Debug line passes a shell set to Warn

vectors.name: error-at-verbose
vectors.why: an Error line is forwarded at Error even on a Verbose shell
